convertersIsolation.rule: Converters must not be imported outside the owning entity; only entities/<name>/api may import entities/<name>/converters (prefer relative ../converters).

noRestrictedImports.message: Converters are private to the entity. Import only from entities/<name>/api via relative '../converters'. UI must use frontend models from RTK hooks.

openapiTypesIsolation.rule: Raw Api.ts / OpenAPI schema types may be imported only in entities/*/types (as T*Backend). Converters, api, handlers, mock, and UI must not import generated/Api or schema symbols from @/shared/api.

noRestrictedImports.message: Raw Api.ts types are allowed only in entities/*/types (*-backend.interface.ts). Alias them as T*Backend and import from ../types.
